description:
Cyber Security Awareness Campaign*

Date: 26 October 2026
Venue: S.N.D.T. Women's University, Churchgate, Mumbai
Organised by: Rotary Club of Mumbai Downtown Sea Land
In Collaboration with: Mumbai Police
Project Head: Prof. Dr. Sanjay sir

Attendance: Approximately 85–90 college students

1. *Project Overview*

Rotary Club of Mumbai Downtown Sea Land, in collaboration with Mumbai Police, successfully organised a Cyber Security Awareness Campaign at S.N.D.T. Women's University, Churchgate, Mumbai, on 26 October 2026.

The programme aimed to educate college students about the growing risks of cybercrime and equip them with essential knowledge to protect themselves in the digital world.

2. *Key Guidance Points Covered*

1. Online Financial Fraud
Students were educated about UPI fraud, OTP scams, fake payment links and fraudulent banking calls. They were advised never to share their OTP, UPI PIN or confidential banking information with anyone.
